description: This file contains functions related to behavioral analysis, specifically handling behavioral strings, creating transition matrices, generating GraphViz scripts, and visualizing transitions in a behavioral research software called BORIS. It includes methods for analyzing behavioral sequence data, constructing transition matrices, converting matrices to GraphViz code, and creating flow diagrams, with integration for GUI dialogs.

methods.name: behavioral_strings_analysis(strings, behav_seq_separator)
methods.description: Analyzes sequences of behavioral strings, splitting them based on a separator and identifying unique behaviors.

methods.name: str observed_transitions_matrix(sequences, behaviours, mode="frequency")
methods.description: Creates a normalized transition matrix of observed behaviors based on sequences, modes include frequency, count, or frequencies after behaviors.

methods.name: tuple create_transitions_gv_from_matrix(matrix, cutoff_all=0, cutoff_behavior=0, edge_label="percent_node")
methods.description: Generates GraphViz code from a transition matrix to visualize behavioral transitions as a graph.

methods.name: transitions_matrix(self, mode)
methods.description: Generates transition matrices for selected observations and behaviors, with options for file saving and GUI dialogs.

methods.name: transitions_dot_script()
methods.description: Creates GraphViz dot scripts from transition matrices stored in files, facilitating visualization.

methods.name: transitions_flow_diagram()
methods.description: Creates flow diagrams of behavioral transitions using GraphViz, if installed, from selected transition matrix files.
